input_limitations: Computed approximate ephemeris, not authoritative astrometry
Sun uses the production Python Earth-opposition formula; annual seasonality is controlled
Measured solar weather and randomly drawn divinations are not included
Twelve implemented stylized engines share inputs; they are not twelve independent experiments
forecast_model: Fixed ridge100, annual past-label-only refits; feature ablation, not historical LLM answers

primary_cost.basis: Illustrative index paper exposure; no executable index fills, borrow/funding excluded
